descriptor.name: Windhoek Cadastral1 public cadastral copy
descriptor.operator: Public ArcGIS publisher; provider asserts municipal data origin
descriptor.scope: Hosted cadastral copy with Windhoek urban-sector discovery evidence. Initial qualification uses three exact parcels only; no citywide completeness or currentness claim.
descriptor.attribution: Windhoek municipality (origin claimed by Cadastral1 publisher); public hosted copy attributed to 2013, with positional and attribute inaccuracies.
descriptor.licenceNote: Item licenseInfo is null. Municipal endorsement, explicit reuse rights and redistribution authority remain unverified.

jurisdiction.basis: Provider item identifies Windhoek municipal cadastral information; official City Geomatics confirms municipal survey/mapping function but does not authenticate this copy.

sourceClassification.basis: Provider identifies cadastral information obtained from Windhoek municipality. Actual polygon features use PRCL_KEY parcel keys. Official City page independently confirms municipal land-surveying and mapping purpose; municipal endorsement of the copy is not established.

followUps: Municipal authentication, source custodianship, explicit reuse and redistribution rights remain unverified; provider claims 2013 origin and warns of inaccuracies.
PRCL_KEY survives two exact reads only if qualification succeeds; long-term durability, historical/current status codebook and broader uniqueness require second-pass review.

Hosted CRS metadata declares Web Mercator WKID 102100/latest 3857; provider returns requested EPSG:4326 GeoJSON. Original survey datum, axis provenance, transformation operation and grid proof are deferred.
Initial pass does not run 13-cell sampling, forced pagination, explicit absence, binding or native-coordinate alignment. Saved metric results describe only the actual exact-read cache.
No geometry repair, clipping, precision rounding, translation or fitted offsets are applied.
